div.head: III Atr 4.1
div.ab: Si tunc sit immundus, percutiatur, ut collum ei frangatur; et si uitet ordalium, reddat semel captale suum repetenti et terre domino uiginti oras et eat rursus ad ordalium.
Gif he þonne ful beo, slea man hine, þæt him forberste se swéora; ⁊ gif he þæt ordal forbuge, gilde angylde þam agenan frian ⁊ landrícan XX óran ⁊ gá eft to þam órdale.
Gif he þonne ful beo, slea man hine, þæt him forberste se swéora; ⁊ gif he þæt ordal forbuge, gilde angylde þam agenan frian ⁊ landrícan XX óran ⁊ gá eft to þam órdale.

If then he is proved guilty, he shall be struck such a blow as shall break his neck. But if he evades the ordeal, he shall pay the value [of the goods] to their owner, and 20 ores to the lord of the manor, and shall thereafter go to the ordeal.

If then he is convicted, he is to be struck so that his neck is broken; and if he fails to appear at the ordeal, he is to pay the simple value of the stolen goods to the owner and 20 ores to the lord of the estate, and go to the ordeal afterwards.

Wenn er aber [beim Ordal] schuldig befunden wird, schlage man ihn, dass ihm das Genick bricht; und wenn er den [ersten] Ordal[termin] vermeidet, zahle er [den Sachwerth des Gestohlenen] an dessen Eigenthümer einfach und dem Immunitätsherrn 20 Ör und schreite nachher zum Ordale.

But if he is found guilty [at the ordeal], let him be struck so that his neck breaks; and if he avoids the [first appointed] ordeal, let him pay the owner [the value of the stolen goods] once and the lord of the immunity 20 ores, and go to the ordeal afterwards.
